rules.rule: Launch all five x1 lanes exactly once through existing lane surfaces.
rules.acceptance: Launch receipts exist for app and CLI lanes.

rules.rule: Do not manually poll before the configured x1 or x2 gate unless a helper emits an explicit blocker.
rules.acceptance: Cadence guard exists before status harvest.

rules.rule: Use wait windows for source research, phase reflection, repair planning, and x2 build queue synthesis.
rules.acceptance: Productive wait research and eureka task plan receipts exist.

rules.rule: Use watchers, notifiers, repair runners, redactors, and normalizers as the lane supervision chain.
rules.acceptance: Completion is decided by app gate, CLI quality, marker review, and five-lane normalizer.

rules.rule: Phase advancement requires all five sibling responses or a scoped blocker receipt.
rules.acceptance: Five-lane normalizer and phase-advance gate pass before closeout.
Cadence receipts only authorize checking; they do not mark lanes complete.
